note: The carried set is every document `backends/go/emit.py::emit` routes to
OBSERVABLE component (issue #1321). `carried` has to mean `builds`, so
tests/test_go_carried_set_builds.py emits the whole set and runs
`go build` over it. Every carried document that emits must build unless
it is named here, with the diagnostic it still produces.
This list is a RATCHET. Removing an entry is the only edit that needs no
argument. Adding one needs the reason in the entry and an issue behind
it: a carried document that does not build is a defect, not a baseline.

known_bad.backends/java/scenarios/runtime_values.r: issue #1356 family 2 - a `host` call in a top-level pure fn lowers as `Pool.Open(...)`, a method on the host-runtime type, where the constructor is the free function `PoolOpen`. The component-step renderer lowers the same call correctly; the pure-tier fn renderer never learned the host calling convention, because before #1321 no document put a host call in a pure fn beside a live component.
known_bad.bench/results/baseline-deepseek-v4-pro/0: issue #1356 family 1 - a provide method declares `-> List[Row]` over a declared record `Row` and returns an untyped `pool.query(sql)`. Reproduces on the rust tier too (`Vec<Row>` against `Vec<Value>`), so it is a frontend typing hole, not a go lowering.
known_bad.tests/fixtures/emit_java_corpus/componen: issue #1356 family 2 - `_emit_host_stubs` answers a host beyond Pool/Map with a FUNCTION stub (`func JobRun(_args ...any) any`), while `_host_type_of_acquire` types the bind as a `*Job` value with methods. The two disagree, and the component's Opt config field lowers to a two-value read of a one-value field.
